facts.fact: 拍卖图录第 13 号拍品：Mary Quant 约 1968 年的黑色直身连衣裙。
facts.anchor: Lot 13: Black shift dress by Mary Quant, circa 1968.

facts.fact: 派对前夜：Nancy 的裙子拉链卡住，她赤脚冲出卧室喊 Miriam 进房解围；试装数轮后选定一条贴身的鸢尾蓝丝裙，Miriam 夸她 "Like a movie star"。
facts.anchor: ‘Miriam? Is that you?’ Nancy shouted, bursting from her bedroom, barefooted, twisting to yank at the jammed zip of her dress.

facts.fact: Nancy 嫌 Doris 的安排荒唐，要 Miriam 别理会老 Doris、以"我的客人"身份赴会，并拍着胸口承诺给她弄到邀请；她弟弟也要三姐弟都来。
facts.anchor: ‘What? That’s ridiculous. Take no notice of old Doris. You must come as a guest. My guest.’

facts.fact: Nancy 说 Lawrence 的女友 Margo 改了意大利暑期计划（放下罗马来 Rushwood）、将到场，Lawrence 想介绍两人；Miriam 心沉，不想见 Margo。
facts.anchor: ‘Margo, his gal is coming,’ Nancy added. ‘I guess he wants to introduce you.’

facts.fact: 窗中所见：Pamela 从棕榈房玻璃门冲出，低头快走、不理 Alf 的呼喊；Doris 从棕榈房另一侧现身与 Alf 简短交谈，随后 Alf 跑去追 Pamela。
facts.anchor: Suddenly, Pamela shot out of its glass door. Moments later, Alf straightened in a nearby bed and stabbed his fork into the soil, where he’d been settling fresh nursery stock. He seemed to call Pamela back, but she kept walking, head down. Doris appeared from the far side of the palm house and had a brief exchange with Alf, who ran off after Pamela.

facts.fact: 全家凌晨四点半起身抢工；七点 Ma 端上吐司和熏鲱鱼，Pa 举杯说"我们做到了"，挨个致谢 Ma、Alf、Pamela 却跳过我（Miriam）；Ma 在桌下握住我的手。
facts.anchor: nodding at Ma, Alf, Pamela, thanking them in quick succession, skipping over me. Under the table, Ma squeezed my hand.

facts.fact: Nancy 把 Quant 黑裙正式送给 Miriam，让她穿去派对"给 Margo 一点颜色看看"；随后又把那条 Biba 白框墨镜一并相送，并送上格言 "Dress for the life you want, not the one you have."
facts.anchor: ‘It’s yours. Every girl needs a little black dress. I’ll never be that thin again, Miriam. You can wear it to the party.’ She grinned. ‘Give Margo a run for her money, go on.’

facts.fact: Miriam 抱着裙子出门时，走廊另一头 Celia 的私人套房门开了，出来的是 Rafe——喘着气、衣衫不整、正拉裤链——他压低声音求 Miriam "别说出去"，随后慌张跟在她身后下楼。
facts.anchor: Instead, Rafe, breathless, dishevelled, zipping his jeans. At the sight of me, he startled. ‘Don’t tell,’ he whispered, pressing his hands together in mock prayer. ‘Please, Miriam. I’ll owe you for ever.’
